nodes.description: Permittable.EIP712_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR, the EIP-712 domain hash used to build permit digests.
Permittable.nonces mapping(address=>uint256), incremented on every permit call to prevent signature replay.
Oracle._cumulative, last stored Uniswap cumulative price of the tracked token.
Oracle._timestamp, last stored uint32 block timestamp from the pair.
Oracle._reserve, last recorded reserve of the counter token used for validity checks.
Oracle._initialized boolean flag that decides between bootstrap and update paths in capture().
Oracle._dao, privileged address allowed to call setup() and capture() through the onlyDao modifier.
Pool._state.balance (staged/claimable/bonded/phantom totals) aggregated accounting for the liquidity pool.
Pool._state.provider (dao, ethic, univ2) addresses of external contracts the pool trusts.
Storage.State._state of the Stake/Deployer contracts holding epoch, balance, provider, accounts, epochs and candidates.
Upgradeable.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant, the EIP-1967 slot holding the proxy implementation address.
Ethic.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) which skips allowance decrement when allowance equals uint256(-1).
Permittable.permit(...) verifying an EIP-712 signature with ecrecover and consuming a nonce before approving.
Oracle.capture(), onlyDao entrypoint that bootstraps or updates the oracle and returns a price and validity flag.
Oracle.updatePrice(), computes the TWAP from cumulative prices using block timestamp deltas.
Oracle.setup(), onlyDao, creates the ETHC/DAI Uniswap pair and records the token index.
Pool.deposit(uint256) that pulls UNI-V2 from msg.sender before incrementing the staged balance.
Pool.withdraw(uint256) that sends UNI-V2 out before decrementing the staged balance.
Pool.claim(uint256) that sends ETHC out before decrementing the claimable balance.
Pool.bond(uint256) that unfreezes the caller, computes phantom rewards and moves staged to bonded.
Pool.unbond(uint256) that converts bonded positions into staged and claimable balances.
Pool.provide(uint256) that converts rewarded ETHC into liquidity via addLiquidity and re-bonds the LP tokens.
Pool.emergencyWithdraw(address,uint256), onlyDao, drains an arbitrary token to the DAO.
Liquidity.addLiquidity(uint256) that transfers ETHC and DAI into the pair and mints LP tokens.
Pool.balanceCheck(), private invariant assertion on UNI-V2 balance versus staged plus bonded totals.
Upgradeable.upgradeTo(address), internal routine that rewrites the implementation slot and delegatecalls initialize().
Upgradeable.setImplementation(address), private function writing the implementation address into the EIP-1967 slot.
Deployer1.initialize(), initializer-guarded bootstrap deploying the Ethic token.
Deployer1.implement(address), public and unguarded entrypoint that forwards to upgradeTo.
Deployer2.initialize(), initializer-guarded bootstrap deploying and setting up the Oracle.
Deployer2.implement(address), public and unguarded entrypoint that forwards to upgradeTo.
Deployer3.initialize(), initializer-guarded bootstrap deploying the Pool.
Deployer3.implement(address), public and unguarded entrypoint that forwards to upgradeTo.
Ethic.mint(address,uint256), onlyMinter, mints new ETHC supply.
msg.sender, attacker controllable caller address used for authorization and accounting.
block.timestamp, miner-influenceable time source consumed by the oracle and epoch logic.
Low-level delegatecall of initialize() on the caller supplied newImplementation inside upgradeTo.
ecrecover(digest, v, r, s) in permit, returns address(0) on malformed signatures.
ethic().transfer(msg.sender, value) executed in claim before claimable state is decremented.
univ2().transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), value) executed in deposit and addLiquidity.
univ2().transfer(msg.sender, value) executed in withdraw before staged state is decremented.
IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(address(this)) external liquidity minting call.
IUniswapV2Factory(UNISWAP_FACTORY).createPair(_ethic, dai()) external call in Oracle.setup.
Inline assembly sstore(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT, newImplementation) writing the proxy implementation pointer.
Unchecked uint subtraction (priceCumulative - _cumulative) and (blockTimestamp - _timestamp) where overflow is intended.
IERC20(token).transfer(address(dao()), value) transferring arbitrary tokens out of the pool.
Parameter value of Pool.deposit(uint256), amount of UNI-V2 staged.
Parameter amount of Ethic.transferFrom, deducted from allowance and balances.
Parameter owner of permit, the signer whose approval is granted.
Parameter spender of permit, the address receiving the allowance.
Parameter deadline of permit, compared against now for signature expiry.
Parameter newImplementation of upgradeTo, the address written to the proxy slot and delegatecalled.
Parameter token of Pool.emergencyWithdraw, the ERC20 drained by the DAO.
Parameter ethicAmount of addLiquidity, ETHC amount converted into liquidity.
Parameter account of Ethic.mint, recipient of newly minted tokens.
Local digest variable of permit, the EIP-712 message hash fed to ecrecover.
Local recovered variable of permit, the signer recovered from ecrecover.
Local timeElapsed variable of updatePrice, uint32 difference of block timestamps.
Local price variable of updatePrice, the computed Decimal TWAP result.
Local daiAmount variable of addLiquidity, quoted DAI pulled from msg.sender.
Local success variable of upgradeTo, the boolean result of the delegatecall.
Local newPhantom variable of bond, the phantom reward credited to the bonder.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender of Ethic.transferFrom and drives the allowance accounting.
msg.sender is validated by the onlyMinter modifier before Ethic.mint executes.
The amount parameter flows into allowance and balance subtraction inside transferFrom.
The account parameter is the mint recipient passed to _mint inside Ethic.mint.
permit reads EIP712_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR to build the digest.
permit reads and post-increments nonces[owner] to prevent replay.
The owner parameter indexes the nonce and is the expected signer.
The spender parameter receives the approval through _approve at the end of permit.
The deadline parameter is compared with now, a timestamp dependency in permit.
permit invokes ecrecover to derive the signer from the digest and signature components.
The local digest is the first argument of ecrecover.
The ecrecover return value is stored in the local recovered variable.
recovered is compared against owner and address(0) inside permit before approval.
block.timestamp is consumed through currentBlockTimestamp to derive the oracle price, a timestamp dependency.
updatePrice reads _cumulative to compute the price delta.
updatePrice reads _timestamp to compute the elapsed time.
updatePrice performs unchecked subtractions of cumulative price and timestamp where overflow is desired.
The computed price is stored in the local price variable.
updatePrice writes the new cumulative price back into _cumulative.
updatePrice writes the new block timestamp back into _timestamp.
capture calls updateOracle which calls updatePrice on the initialized path.
The onlyDao modifier compares msg.sender with _dao before capture runs.
_dao is the trusted address checked by the onlyDao modifier on capture.
capture flips _initialized to true when bootstrap initialization succeeds.
Oracle.setup performs an external createPair call on the Uniswap factory.
deposit performs an external token transfer before staged balances are updated.
The value parameter is the amount transferred and staged in Pool.deposit.
claim sends ETHC to msg.sender before decrementing the claimable balance.
The ETHC transfer can call back into claim before the claimable accounting is updated.
claim decrements the pool claimable accounting in _state.balance.
withdraw transfers UNI-V2 out before decrementing the staged balance.
The UNI-V2 transfer may re-enter withdraw while staged balances are still stale.
withdraw decrements the pool staged accounting in _state.balance.
deposit increments the pool staged accounting in _state.balance.
The token transferFrom in deposit can re-enter deposit before balance increments complete.
provide calls addLiquidity to convert rewarded ETHC into UNI-V2.
addLiquidity calls mint on the Uniswap pair to obtain liquidity tokens.
The pair mint call is an external call that can re-enter the pool before bonding updates.
The ethicAmount parameter is transferred into the pair inside addLiquidity.
The quoted DAI amount is stored in the local daiAmount variable.
addLiquidity performs an external transferFrom of DAI from the caller before accounting updates.
provide calls balanceCheck to assert the UNI-V2 invariant.
emergencyWithdraw moves arbitrary tokens out of the pool through an external transfer.
The onlyDao modifier compares msg.sender with address(dao()) before the emergency drain.
The token parameter selects which ERC20 is drained by emergencyWithdraw.
unbond calls balanceCheck after mutating bonded and phantom balances.
deposit calls balanceCheck after staging tokens.
withdraw calls balanceCheck after unstaging tokens.
claim calls balanceCheck after paying out ETHC.
bond calls balanceCheck after moving staged tokens into bonded positions.
bond updates bonded and phantom accounting in _state.balance.
The computed newPhantom local is credited to the bonder inside bond.
Deployer1.implement is public with no restriction and forwards directly to upgradeTo.
Deployer2.implement is public with no restriction and forwards directly to upgradeTo.
Deployer3.implement is public with no restriction and forwards directly to upgradeTo.
The caller supplied newImplementation parameter reaches the upgrade routine.
upgradeTo delegatecalls initialize() on the attacker controlled implementation address.
newImplementation is the delegatecall target and thus fully controls proxy execution.
upgradeTo calls setImplementation to persist the new implementation address.
setImplementation writes the implementation slot with inline assembly sstore.
The delegatecall result is stored in the local success variable checked by require.
Deployer1.initialize writes the new Ethic token into the stored provider state.
Deployer2.initialize writes the new Oracle into the stored provider state.
Deployer3.initialize writes the new Pool address into the stored provider state.
setImplementation uses the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant as the storage location.
deposit is gated by onlyFrozen(msg.sender), tying caller status to execution.
claim is gated by onlyFrozen(msg.sender), tying caller status to execution.

normalization_plan.reason: The value parameter exists only to size the deposit and should be folded into Pool.deposit.
The amount parameter is a transient input of Ethic.transferFrom and belongs to that function node.
The owner parameter is consumed only by permit signature verification and approval.
The spender parameter is used only for the final _approve call inside permit.
The deadline parameter is a permit-local expiry check with no independent semantic identity.
newImplementation is the exact delegatecall target, so it should be merged into that unsafe operation.
The token parameter only selects the ERC20 drained by the emergency transfer operation.
ethicAmount is a transient liquidity sizing input and should be folded into addLiquidity.
The account parameter is only the mint recipient inside Ethic.mint.
digest is the direct input of ecrecover and has no meaning outside that unsafe operation.
recovered is a short-lived verification result used only inside permit's require checks.
timeElapsed is the product of the intentionally unchecked timestamp subtraction and merges into it.
price is the transient return value of updatePrice and belongs to that function node.
daiAmount is a transient quote used only within addLiquidity.
success merely captures the delegatecall outcome and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
newPhantom is a transient reward computation local to Pool.bond.
